brief.title: 07:00 — The First Bake
brief.prompt: At 07:00, frame saltbread lower-right: scorched-seam, uneven-salt, foreground-cropped torn-heel; frayed-linen beneath. "Camera: 90mm macro at f/4 for a single hero item or 50mm at f/5.6 for a table; camera at 30–45° above the table (never 90° top-down unless the world is brutal), tripod." "Light: Backlight-key: a soft window or 1×1 m diffusion behind and 45° to one side of the food so steam, crumbs and glaze rim-light; white fill card from the front at 2:1 to open the shadows. Small black flag to keep the front from going flat. Steam only if the food is actually hot in the story." Editorial still-life photography, one cohesive series, shot on medium format with a 80mm lens. Color grading: warm neutral base, a single accent hue close to #b45309, low saturation, no neon. Lighting: soft directional window light from the left, bright and airy, gentle long shadows, no flash. Texture: fine film grain, matte surfaces, shallow depth of field on the subject only. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts anywhere in the frame. No text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks, no frame or border. Composition leaves clean negative space in the upper-left third for a headline.
brief.negative: No people or body parts; no text, logos, packaging, watermarks or borders. No additional rolls, plate, knife, butter dish or salt bowl: only the saltbread, its torn heel and supporting linen. No artificial steam from this cooled first bake. No uniform salt placement, flawless crust, varnish-like glaze, floating food, synthetic surfaces or CGI appearance. No centred arrangement, overhead view, clutter in the upper-left headline area, orange cast, neon or flash. No independent secondary light source; fill is reflected window light.
